newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-CAMEROON'S MBOMA PUTS GAMBA OSAKA ON TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAMEROON'S MBOMA PUTS GAMBA OSAKA ON TOP.

text.p: Cameroonian striker Patrick Mboma scored a goal and assisted on three others to lift perennial cellar-dwellers Gamba Osaka to the top of the J. League on Wednesday.
Mboma, formerly with Paris St. Germain, gave his side a surprise 4-0 victory over Yokohama Marinos on the second leg of the J.League which began its season last week.
Brazil's Valber scored twice to keep the Yokohama Flugels in second place in a 2-0 victory over Cerezo Osaka.
Jubilo Iwata kept a clean slate by defeating Avispa Fukuoka 1-0 in a sudden-death goal by midfielder Takashi Fukunishi in extra time.
In Kobe, veteran Akihiro Nagashima scored a sudden-death goal, his second goal in the match, to give Kobe their first J. League victory with a 2-1 win over Nagoya Grampus Eight.

Kyoto Purple Sanga crushed JEF United Ichihara 4-2 while Verdy Kawasaki defeated Bellmare Hiratsuka 2-0. Brazil's Edilson scored twice to lead Kashiwa Reysol to a 3-2 win over Sanfrecce Hiroshima and Urawa Red Diamonds edged Shimizu S-Pulse 1-0.
